notes: «وفي حديثه قال فلقيت أبا جعفر» : Abu Ja'far speaks inside the narrator's encounter, so he is the last link of that remark (owner ruling 5). It is a variant (the remark names another transmitter for the same saying), not a route.
The chain before the variant ends at «بهذا الإسناد» (the earlier report's chain, not written here).
